'''Thok''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] warrior who served [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]] as well as the forces of [[Arden Lyn]] and [[Demetrius Zaarin]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Thok was born and raised on [[Pzob/Legends|Pzob]], alongside his brother [[Gorc]]. Although they were typical of their species in the sense of their innate desire for battle and hatred of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], Thok and Gorc were also unique in that they possessed a "[[The Force/Legends|magical power]]" where, when they finished a huge brunch topped off with a gallon of Gamorrean hooch and engaged in impromptu fisticuffs, they belched a fireball. After their inadvertent first attempt had occurred that resulted in flambéing and scorching his clan-rival [[Scumbo/Legends|Scumbo]]'s snout, Thok decided along with his brother to go to other worlds to fight, as there were far bigger hogs to fry than on Pzob.<ref name="Barely Tolerable" />

He eventually bought a translator so he and Gorc could enter fights for various fortunes. Sometime later, they found work on [[Zlarbv IV]] as guinea pigs for the scientist, Dr. [[Pineas Pontak]]'s development of the Pontak Hypergland. This made them swell up their muscles if sufficiently enraged, although the process was painful. After leaving Pontak's employment, they eventually went to Tatooine, where they were recruited by [[Ortugg]] into the bodyguard profession of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and his criminal empire, as Jabba himself saw their potential.<ref name="Barely Tolerable" />

He had many adventures under Jabba's employ. He once bolted when Ortugg told him to bring in the Rancor, as he recognized the creature as being the mythological spider-crab from [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]] mythology when one such creature was introduced to their planet by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Rakata Empire]] millennia back. He also ratted out Pontak's location to Jabba when the latter required his presence to one-up [[Suppoon]], his gang rival, in a Punjab. He received a promotion to personal bodyguard for this due to Jabba being impressed with his deduction.<ref name="Barely Tolerable" />

He and his brother were eventually arrested by [[Sariss|The Prophetess]] one night on [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley's]] bar where he and Gorc, after drinking seven gallons of Zelostian wine, got into an immense bar fight where he and Gorc, with a Kloo Horn, bludgeoned three [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] patrons to death, as well as fricasseed five [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] patrons. He exposed Gorc's ability to erupt fire in an attempt to save his own hide, although this only resulted in their separation, with Thok specifically being placed in [[Prefect/Legends|Prefect]] [[Orun Depp]]'s prisons to rot while Gorc was experimented on.<ref name="wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050609a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 5: Two Peas in a Pod}}</ref>

[[File:Thok_teras_kasi.png|thumb|left|Thok]]

He was eventually freed by the ancient and cybernetic [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Arden Lyn]], in exchange for supplying the Prophetess with information regarding a [[Panatha]]n [[Yun's father|mineral baron]], as she had sensed his Force potential. Thok, due to his species' hatred of mechanical things as well as Gamorr tradition, informed her that he'd rather die than serve someone who couldn't defeat him in single combat, especially someone who was part-droid. Although it was a grueling fight, Thok ended up defeated by a single uppercut from Lyn's cybernetic arm. Lyn, impressed with his Force-enhanced abilities, then recruited him into her Teräs Käsi students, alongside the Force-sensitive [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[17786]] and the former [[Grave Tuskens]] member [[KkH'Oar'Rrhr]]. He trained extensively for Lyn's mission to terminate the "[[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]]," and managed to engage them in battle, with [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] being a particularly challenging foe. In truth, however, Lyn was gathering soldiers to overthrow Emperor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Unfortunately for Lyn, fellow Emperor's Hand [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] reported her treachery to her master, prompting Lyn and Thok to disappear. Months after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Thok and Lyn reemerged, now in league with [[Demetrius Zaarin]] and his [[Zaarin insurrection|coup]] against Emperor Palpatine. Taking a page from the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|last battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Thok assisted Lyn and Trooper 17786 with [[Treachery at Ottega|abducting]] the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] abord the [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|shuttle]] [[Haven 3]]. After the coup failed, he was subsequently released from Lyn's service.<ref name="Barely Tolerable" />

Thok returned to working for Jabba; he would be one of nine [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards on duty in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. He was an interior guard, and served alongside [[Thug/Legends|Thug]]. To his dismay, his old clan rival Scumbo had taken his brother's spot in the guard. Despite this, Thok did feel some satisfaction upon seeing Chewbacca's [[Han Solo/Legends|sidekick]] frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. Things quickly heated up when he recognized the dancer Arica was actually Emperor's Hand Mara Jade. Thok was about to inform Jabba that he had a spy in his midst when all hell broke loose. Han Solo was defrosted by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and Luke Skywalker had killed the rancor. With Mara Jade and the Heroes of Yavin in the palace at the same time, Thok felt they were surely out to get him.<ref name="Barely Tolerable" />
[[File:Double Laser Cannon CCG.jpg|thumb|Thok attempted to stop the deck cannon but failed to save the sail barge.]]
He accompanied the other Gamorreans on Jabba's [[Khetanna/Legends|sail barge]] to watch the Rebels' [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|execution]]. When Luke broke free and began hacking down [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] guards, Thok jumped into action. He ran to the top deck, body slamming [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] in the process, and began prepping the deck cannon with [[Wooof/Legends|Wooof]]. When Luke boarded the sail barge, Thok charged him from behind hoping to catch him off guard with a fireball to the face. Luke sensed Thok's incoming attack and struck him down. In his dying moments, he saw Scumbo looking down at him. Although Thok feared that he was going to be killed by his hated nemesis, Scumbo instead honored the dying Gamorrean by bidding his old foe safe passage to the [[Great Trough in the Stars]], before squealing the Gamorrean war cry as the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] exploded around them. Clan Skunnt would remember Thok forever, memorializing the might brawler with a burping contest on his birthday every year. <ref name="Barely Tolerable" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thok was introduced in the fighting game ''[[Star Wars: Masters of Teräs Käsi]]'', which established him to be a [[Force Adept]]. ''[[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]]'' [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] one of the Gamorrean guards in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] to be Thok. He was established to be Gorc's brother in [[The Dark Forces Saga]]. He was eventually given an extensive history in part 2 of [[Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire]], which also retconned his homeworld as being Pzob instead of Gamorr, which ''The Dark Forces Saga'' had implied. In addition, although his role in Gorc becoming a [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] was retained, the exact circumstances were different: In ''The Dark Forces Saga'', he sold him out to prevent his going into slavery when Imperial slavers arrived on the planet, but in Barely Tolerable, he instead squealed on the Imperials on Gorc's Force Potential when they were arrested for a violent brawl at Mos Eisley in an attempt to save their hide.
